task: Multi-object tracking from frame detections to complete trajectories
primary_input: Consecutive image frames represented through per-frame detections with bounding boxes and confidence scores
primary_output: Identity labels and associated bounding-box trajectories across frames
scientific_target: Handle occlusions in crowded scenes by decomposing dense target sets into sparse subsets via pseudo-depth estimation and hierarchical association
named_methods: SparseTrack-like pseudo-depth decomposition and hierarchical association
